description: This is a PHP class implementing an OAuth authorization code entity for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages OAuth authorization code data such as redirect URI, expiration, associated client, user ID, and scopes.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth authorization code, including its identifiers, expiry date, client, user, redirect URI, and scopes.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Retrieves the redirect URI associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration date-time of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration date-time, overriding with a value computed from current time plus TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the associated user identifier, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Associates a user identifier with the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client entity for the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Retrieves all scopes associated with the auth code.
